name: NMDC Group
verdict: Alpha Dhabi Holding holds about 77% of NMDC Group; International Holding Company is Alpha Dhabi Holding's parent; IHC is controlled by Royal Group, Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan's holding.
note: Abu Dhabi dredging/energy EPC group; on the chest and sleeves of the 2026 UAE Team L'IMAD kit. Rating note: proposed none by the contributor of 2026-10-03, on hold for a maintainer. The chain is NMDC Group -> Alpha Dhabi Holding (~77%, AD Ports Group press release 2025-11-27) -> IHC (parent company per Alpha Dhabi's 2025 financial report) -> Royal Group, treated as Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed's private holding (the G42 review of 2026-09-27 treated Royal Group as private, not the state). No state stake sourced in the chain. Company check open before a none rating: the Business & Human Rights Resource Centre records reports that 10 workers died (5 in industrial accidents) and 145 were injured on the New Suez Canal construction in Egypt in 2015, where NMDC was in the Challenge Consortium and responded to the Centre's request (https://www.business-humanrights.org/en/latest-news/suez-canal-development-in-egypt-reports-of-worker-injuries-and-deaths/) - the maintainer should weigh this against the company test. No other human-rights finding against NMDC, Alpha Dhabi or IHC sourced.
